meta.title: Auditsmith Gallery
meta.subtitle: Every block, every variant, every edge case

cover.title: Auditsmith
cover.subtitle: The component showroom. If a change looks wrong anywhere, it shows up here first.

sections.text: This file exercises every block type with dummy data, including deliberate edge cases. After changing any token, atom, or block, render this file and scan every page. Blocks appear in the order: heading, paragraph, keyValue, scorecard, metrics, findings, table, sectionDivider.

sections.title: Text Blocks
sections.description: heading and paragraph, including long-content wrapping tests.

sections.text: A normal paragraph with a single sentence.
A deliberately long heading to check how the heading style wraps when it runs past a single line width

A long paragraph to test line height and wrapping. Performance budgets only work when the whole team can see them, so this report is generated from a single source of truth and rendered identically every time. Repetition, repetition, repetition: the paragraph needs at least four lines to properly show the rhythm of the body face, its line height, and the spacing to the next block. Numbers inside a paragraph like 4,659 KiB and 2.5 s render in the body font, not the mono font.

sections.title: Key-Value Box
sections.description: Label widths, long values, and many rows.

items.label: Long value
items.value: A long value that should wrap within the box rather than overflow it, staying aligned to the value column while the label column keeps its fixed width

items.label: Fifth row
items.value: Boxes with many rows should not split across pages

sections.title: Scorecard
sections.description: All three colour bands, the display override, and a non-100 max.

sections.text: Expected: red, amber, green, green (2/2), green. A score of exactly 90 sits in the green band; exactly 50 would sit in amber.

sections.title: Metrics
sections.description: All four ratings including the grey fallback, plus a typo test.

items.label: A metric label long enough to test how the row handles wrapping against the value

sections.title: Findings
sections.description: All five severities, minimal vs maximal fields, and long-text wrapping.

items.title: Critical severity card
items.description: A card using every available field: id, title, severity, category, description, impact, recommendation.
items.recommendation: Use critical sparingly; it should mean production is at risk.

items.title: Medium severity card
items.impact: Amber badge, dark text for contrast
items.recommendation: The most common severity in practice.

items.title: Minimal card: title and severity only, no id, category, impact, or recommendation
Typo severity falls back to the info style
items.recommendation: If this badge is not grey, the fallback logic broke.

items.title: A very long finding title that should wrap onto a second line while the severity badge stays pinned to the top right corner of the card
items.description: Long description test. The description, impact, and recommendation lines should all wrap cleanly inside the card border with consistent line height, and the card itself should never split across a page break because of the wrap=false rule on cards.
items.impact: Long impact line: est savings of 4,659 KiB across 37 assets on 12 templates, affecting every landing page variant currently in rotation
items.recommendation: Long recommendation line: consolidate the asset pipeline, enable content hashing, set immutable cache headers, and re-run the audit to confirm the savings landed as projected.

sections.title: Table
sections.description: Alternating rows, many columns, and cell wrapping.

rows: A cell with long content that should wrap inside its column instead of pushing the table wider

sections.title: Section Divider
sections.description: This block is itself the specimen: numeral in mono, rule, this description line. The next divider tests the no-number variant.

sections.text: Above: a divider with no number and no description should still render its title and rule cleanly.

sections.title: Failure Modes
sections.description: Unknown block types must be skipped silently. Between this line and the closing paragraph below, the JSON contains a block of type doesNotExist. If you can read the closing paragraph, graceful skipping works.

sections.text: This block should never appear in the PDF.
Closing paragraph: if this renders and nothing odd appears above it, unknown-type handling is healthy. End of gallery.

sections.title: Audit Results
sections.description: The results overview block: banner, hero grade, sub-grade row. All five grade colours, modifier handling (C+ colours as C), and the unknown-grade grey fallback.

sections.text: Expected: hero C in amber; sub-grades C+ amber, D deep amber, B deep green, F red, A green.
